fonts.sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Pretendard, astaSans, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif
fonts.serif: Hedvig Letters Serif, NanumMyeongjo, Georgia, serif
fonts.mono: Geist Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

usage.accent: small markers and key conclusions; never stage-specific colors
usage.muted: darkened from landing #71717A for paper readability
usage.serif: optional for extended narrative/source prose, never mandatory for structured evidence or analysis
usage.print: opaque surfaces; no blur or shadows
usage.fonts: local font fallback; no font files bundled
